title: Surreal Chess Portal
description: A woman in a pink dress stands barefoot on a glowing yellow and black chessboard floor, holding a conductor's baton in one hand while a giant white peony grows beside her. Behind her are two large open circular doorways revealing a checkered room with empty picture frames and a framed screaming mask, as a flaming comet with a small white figure streaks across the dark floral wallpaper above.
prompt: A surreal dark scene featuring a barefoot woman in a short pink dress standing on a glowing yellow and black chessboard. She holds a thin baton and stands beside an enormous white peony flower. Behind her are two large circular open portals revealing a room with floating empty picture frames and a framed screaming mask on the wall. A bright fiery comet with a small white figure inside streaks across the top of the image against black wallpaper decorated with large white flowers. Dramatic lighting, high contrast, detailed linework.
